scope.purpose: Both play-time setting keys stop working after menu/all-buttons disable, and work again after menu redisplay.
scope.fixture: Explicit first_join and initial setting; frozen ticks suppress scheduled redisplay. Actual menu registration, disable, trigger dispatch and setting listeners run. Trigger score is supplied directly as the chat click input. Private function calls are diagnostic boundaries.

steps.name: Explicit player initialization in frozen test world
commands: gamerule doMobSpawning false
gamemode creative VerifySettings
execute as VerifySettings at @s run function core:handler/first_join
fill -3 79 -3 3 79 3 stone
tp VerifySettings 0.5 80 0.5
clear VerifySettings
scoreboard objectives add SettingsVerify dummy
scoreboard players set READY SettingsVerify 1

steps.name: DISABLE_SETTINGS_MENU_ENABLE rejects stale click
commands: data modify storage global Config.ShowPlayTimeOnDispel set value false
execute as VerifySettings at @s run function settings:send_setting_menu
execute as VerifySettings at @s run function settings:disable_settings_menu
execute store result score VerifySettings Trigger run data get storage player_manager:trigger TriggerListeners[{Key:"change_show_play_time_on_dispel_enable"}].ID
execute as VerifySettings at @s run function player_manager:trigger/
execute if data storage global Config{ShowPlayTimeOnDispel:false} run scoreboard players set DISABLE_SETTINGS_MENU_ENABLE_STALE SettingsVerify 1
